name: gpu-training-orchestrator
description: Orchestrate benchmark, formal training, resume, monitoring, ETA estimation, and safe training parameter records.

routing.summary: Use for planning YOLO/RT-DETR training runs, small benchmarks, formal epochs, monitoring results.csv, and selecting safe batch sizes.
examples: 先跑 1 epoch benchmark 再正式训练
生成 RT-DETR 训练命令和监控方案

execution.template:
# GPU 训练编排方案

## 输入

- 模型：${model}
- 数据：${data}
- epochs：${epochs}
- batch：${batch}
- 机器：${machines}

## Benchmark

先跑小样本 benchmark，确认数据路径、类别、显存峰值、单 epoch 耗时和 best.pt 产出链路。

```bash
yolo detect train model=${model} data=${data} epochs=1 batch=${batch} imgsz=640 workers=4 name=benchmark_e1
```

## 正式训练

benchmark 通过后再放大 epochs，并记录 args.yaml、results.csv、best.pt、last.pt。

```bash
yolo detect train model=${model} data=${data} epochs=${epochs} batch=${batch} imgsz=640 patience=8 name=formal_train
```

## 监控

```bash
tail -f runs/detect/formal_train/results.csv
nvidia-smi
```
